name_reason: Already fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), chapter domain (matches sibling end-scene tables in chtab2.c), descriptor reflects both purpose (bottom-half portrait id per game-clear credit-roll duel) and data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue. 'bottom' correctly distinguishes it from the sibling top_portrait_id_table @ 0x525DC.
purpose: Bottom-half fighter portrait id for each of the 20 staff-roll duels shown during the game-clear ending cinematic.
logic_summary: fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic (sole reader @ 0x2bd2f) copies all 20 bytes onto its stack via a MOVSD x5 block copy, then in the credit-roll loop (char_idx 0..0x13) reads one byte per iteration (MOVZX, stride 1): byte < 0x4C sets runtime_char[1].bTeam=2 (ally side) else 0 (enemy side), and the byte is stored into runtime_char[1].bPortrait_id for the bottom fighter of that scripted duel. Companions: top_portrait_id_table @ 0x525DC (top fighter) and scripted_outcome_table @ 0x52604 (per-duel scripted mode/terrain).
element_semantics: Per-duel portrait id (one byte per credit-roll duel, 20 duels). Compared against 0x4C to pick the team side: < 0x4C -> ally (bTeam=2), >= 0x4C -> enemy (bTeam=0). Stored into runtime_char[1].bPortrait_id.
notes: Binary bytes at 0x525F0 (67 14 53 1C 7C 26 5D 22 70 2C 56 35 50 37 78 24 6A 3C 7A 32) are byte-identical to the const array in chtab2.c lines 258-261. Source comment block (lines 243-261) was already precise and accurate vs the decompiler/disassembly, so no Edit to chtab2.c (comment_verdict=keep). Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT was null; created a concise plate (run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)) reflecting the src conclusion. No logic concerns.
